_comment: Safety/HSE wall: exercises the situational detectors — fire/smoke, panic-running, crowd-formation — plus person-fall and violence. Every trigger is verified by TrueSight (the VLM gate). 'synthetic_fire.mp4' is a generated flame clip so the fire path has something to chew on; for a real positive fire/panic/crowd demo, point cameras at real footage. Uses manufacturing_hse_v1 rules for the panic/crowd cameras.
name: Safety Watch
